test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

When the thief __sees the sentry__ at the main gate, he managed to escape from the side gate.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'saw the sentry'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence is **'saw the sentry'.**
 
• The given sentence makes a sense of past incidents that happened some times ago.
 
• So, the underlined segment of the sentence should be in **'Past Tense'.**
 
• Replacing **'sees the sentry'** with **'saw the sentry'** will make it correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 1'.**

**Correct sentence:**__ *When the thief **__saw the sentry__** at the main gate, he managed to escape from the side gate.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'seeing the sentry'** is not correct here.
 
• **'has seen the sentry'** is not correct here.
 
• **'see the sentry'** is not correct here.
